answers.core: The curved line used to draw a connect is programmed at a C++ level, not native gdscript.
answers.workaround:
I can think of other solutions, but they'll take a few extensions of classes at best.
* I could use other control nodes aside from GraphNode, but I'll have to program them to scale accordingly when GraphEdit is zoomed or moved.
* In place of connections, I could use Line2D, but I'm not sure whether using Node2D node in Control is the right way.
